notes.text: Seen at partner hospital emergency department on Sep 18, 2026 for urinary tract infection with acute confusion; treated and released the same day. Discharged on nitrofurantoin 100 MG for 5 days. Follow up with PACE primary care within 7 days.
Assisted with light housekeeping and meal prep. Damaris in good spirits.
Picked up for day center on time; no issues during transport.
Post-hospital follow-up for urinary tract infection with acute confusion. Damaris is back to baseline per her grandson. Reviewed discharge medications. Will monitor closely over the next two weeks.
Routine check. Vitals within her usual range. Medications taken as directed. No new concerns.
Assisted with light housekeeping and meal prep. Damaris in good spirits.
Damaris attended day center, joined chair exercise and music group, and ate most of lunch.
Routine check. Vitals within her usual range. Medications taken as directed. No new concerns.
Medication review. Discontinued Naproxen sodium 220 MG Oral Tablet given declining kidney function and fall risk. Discussed alternatives with Damaris; acetaminophen as needed for pain.
Reconciled list after PCP visit. Naproxen sodium 220 MG Oral Tablet removed from active medications; pharmacy notified.

Damaris reported a fall at home on Oct 12, 2026 in the kitchen while reaching for a cabinet. Her grandson Teresa found her on the floor. Denies head strike or loss of consciousness. Bruising to right hip; able to bear weight, no deformity. Vitals stable. Fall risk reassessed as high. PT referral placed for gait evaluation.

PT evaluation following fall on Oct 12, 2026. Gait slow and unsteady with intermittent cane use; Timed Up and Go 19 seconds. Recommend front-wheeled walker, home safety evaluation, and grab bars in the bathroom. Will see twice weekly for strength and balance.

Met with Teresa, Damaris's grandson and primary caregiver. Teresa reports exhaustion and poor sleep, and is worried about managing evenings alone. Requests respite. Discussed respite options and caregiver support group.
Damaris enjoyed the gardening group and talked about growing tomatoes as a child.
